name: diabetessharp
description: DiabetesSharp - programa de 90 dias para controle da glicemia

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently "npm run dev:no-watch --workspace=server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:client-only: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=client
scripts.dev:server-only: npm run build:shared && npm run dev:no-watch --workspace=server
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
